name: codex-blender-plugin
description: Create and refine Blender scenes from images, optionally incorporate externally generated 3D assets, and inspect scenes in an interactive Three.js viewer.

interface.longDescription: Plan, build and review Blender scenes from images or text. Incorporate detailed GLB assets when a separate 3D generation tool is available, then deliver a render and interactive viewer.
defaultPrompt: Build an orbitable Blender scene from this image. Check available 3D generation tools for prominent high-detail objects, confirm any credit cost before use, and show the render and interactive 3D result.
